interpretation: Hub-first proxy increased 2025 independent selection weeks from 6 to 8 (+33.3%) without relaxing V1.9 selection gates.
Incremental candidates were all positive in absolute terms, but only two of three beat CSI300.
The combined excess-win rate declined from 85.7% to 80.0%; median excess declined from 16.5% to 12.0%. Recall improved more than per-selection edge.
The public proxy is not equivalent to Wind/LSEG/Bloomberg terminal history; results support further testing, not final adoption.
nextAblation: Repeat hub-first discovery on another historical year using the same generic primitives and frozen V1.9 downstream rules.
Keep source-layer and timing-layer changes separate.
Test market-regime opportunity-cost filtering on a different window; do not use the Midea failure to tune and validate on 2025 simultaneously.
